title: SLI, SLO and error budget declared in the platform itself

videos.script: No service is up all the time. So how much down is acceptable? {{question}} First, measure what a user would call a failure. That ratio of good requests to all requests is the indicator. {{sli}} Then set a target for it, over a window. Ninety-nine and a half percent, over twenty-eight days. {{slo}} What is left over is the error budget. It is a number of requests that may fail, and it can be spent. {{budget}} The useful alert is not about the ratio. It asks how fast the budget is burning, and pages someone only when it burns fast and is still burning. {{burn}} You will do the arithmetic on your own computer, then declare it in Cloud Monitoring. {{end}}
